svg.text: Runs from t = 0 s, released at t = 0 s in baseline
Lengths in m, masses in kg
A / B / C — unchanged in shape
Lit now means on the pivot rather than selected. Clicking
one switches that pendulum in or out, down the same path the
links switch takes today, confirm and all. The dot keeps its
g and b — the two forces, above the chains
g comes out of the flight simulator, b up from the foot of
this box. They act on every chain, so they read better above
the three than under them. b still follows the selection. g
greys out while a profile drives it, and the line that used
to say so is a tooltip on the row now. The units line under
them carries the m and kg the grid has no room for.
Selected — a lit surround, whole row
1 px --accent, 7 % accent fill, 5 px radius: exactly a lit
tab, drawn around the row instead of around a letter.
Initial conditions, State and b follow it. Clicking a row
Figure and boxes at full strength, no surround. L_T carries
the accent border because it is the derived one: editing it
scales the links together, editing a link rescales its
siblings and leaves L_T alone. Each step button fills its
whole cell and names the link it moves.
Off — greyed, and the boxes go with it
The figure drops to #565e73 — the grey index.js already uses
for the flight curve when nothing is flying it — and its
seven boxes go. The row is now the switch: click the grey
figure to put the pendulum back on the pivot.
Under the pointer: the accent border every other clickable
thing on this panel answers with, and no fill — which is
what keeps it apart from the lit fill of the selected row.
About 77 px of column. Three pendulums are on the panel at
once where one used to be, and g and b sit above them.
Against that: six slider rows and the links switch come off,
g leaves the flight box, and Clear trails stops being a row
of its own. An off pendulum costs only its 26 px figure, so
switching two off leaves the box shorter than it is today.
